works.body:
Hello. I saw your art on X and liked your precure artwork.
I would like to request a drawing of my magical girl character from my comic, Pretty Angel Heart.  She has a bright and cheerful personality and themed after kindness. I added a few translated pages using machine translation to the reference. You read the pages left to right, american style.

Pose and Expression is up to you.
Please include transparent option as well for thumbnails and for use on Twitter/Youtube.

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/2/folders/1EAC1uIREEiHTn6D1d5YNYPgGOQYUHGiS

Hello!
I wanted to ask if it’s possible for you to draw my character! She’s an oni idol! Her main motif is the moon!
Here is the image! https://f2.toyhou.se/file/f2-toyhou-se/images/69547688_DYCTfTFBmEM80sV.jpg 

Thank you!!!!!

Mr. Sekiguchi, it is nice to meet you. Thank you very much for your support.
I have seen your various absurdly cute illustrations on X (formerly Twitter), and I would like to request your help due to other reasons.

This time, I would like to ask Sekiguchi-sama to draw two of my favorite characters in a happy and cute way.
I would like to see two diffs of them in a princess's embrace, pushing down all my embarrassing feelings.

The first one is of a girl who is happy while being hugged by a princess, with the boy making a face like "I don't know what's making you happy" (I'm not sure how happy she is...I don't know...I feel love with an emotion similar to a sense of security).
I would be happy if you could draw a boy who is kissed by the girl with the difference between the two, and his cool expression collapses and he is excited.

I've posted various reference materials at the URL below, but I'll really leave it up to you to decide how much you want to see.
All of them are the best illustrations that saved my life, but many of them are a little sad and angsty, so please just make them happy with Sekiguchi-sama's cute illustrations, I don't care what it was as long as those two are happy.

I would appreciate it if you could look at the first two URLs to understand the relationship and the characters. The rest of them are cute, but if it's too much trouble, it's fine.
I didn't put illustrations with darker lines as much as possible because it would make it hard for me.

I think that with this much I can draw without having to search for reference materials....
There are various kinds of fan art, but I would be happy if you could make me feel cute and cuddly along the lines of Sekiguchi-sama's illustrations.
I leave it completely up to you how to draw it. If it's too much trouble, you can cancel it at all. If you have any other ideas, you can change the situation.

If you have any other ideas, you can change the situation.
Thank you for giving me a chance to practice this time.

By the way, I like both of them very much, but my favorite is the guy.
Please make him happy.

Doujinshi of the original illustrator (still available on the net) /Please use this work as a standard.
https://photos.app.goo.gl/s3xJhPsKWLERtnLK8

Ghost Ship (a doujinshi of a later version of the main story by someone who later became a professional: it's available for free) / I'd be happy if you could use it to understand the relationships and personalities of the characters.
https://photos.app.goo.gl/SDswo8vnuFFJX5aJA

Official pictures: reference picture of heroine's back hair, original scene of princess hugging & others/ Many of them are very painful for me, but for those who don't know, they are just official pictures!
https://photos.google.com/u/1/share/AF1QipPBX_uG5MFpBfEUeSOzbpsHIFuCW0hftxjEg2d7zqnpBkazzQgAm6-bdamOkYGV7Q?key=bXJVNk9qM2hzTGNFbDd 3TnVIMElqZjVsWDlSeTB3

My favorite painter A's work/ I like his work the most because it fits me the best. I sleep every day looking at his picture of the two smiling faces.
https://photos.google.com/u/1/album/AF1QipM6zL4_CdHsCHxHHs5SbD6n_9FMyWWB19FjGDvE

My favorite painter B's work/I like his work the most, I feel his sexuality.
https://photos.google.com/u/1/album/AF1QipMhXOsROC7St8vGy1nsbBbJKNITNso1hQfbsxYY

Other cute ones and others/ Various other illustrations that saved my life, the Santa one is too cute.
https://photos.google.com/u/1/album/AF1QipP12uek16nUYe_TxNX_np41oWshL60lR62Ob1wZ

I would really appreciate it if you could help me out.
Please draw whatever you really want. I'm happy just to have new illustrations of these two people being happy. Seriously....

Seriously, just do it in your spare time....

Hi, my name is Koala 🙇‍♀️

Thank you for all your wonderful illustrations! I love 🙇‍♀️ sekiguchi's illustrations ✨️

The OC illustration you did for me before was really wonderful, and I thought I would like to ask you to do it again if you could do it for me!

Here are the details

The height difference between the two of them and their appearance should be similar to the illustration below.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1T8oMTwC-MrRsHuEjXDHUFUt2LQ5BX1yC/view?usp=drivesdk

［The approximate situation and atmosphere you would like to create.]

(1) OC2 is jealous of OC1 and is messing with him.

2) OC2 is lying in a field of flowers or grass and smiling at OC1.
I would appreciate it if both of their eyes are open.

Please choose either (1) or (2) whichever is easier for you to draw. 🙇‍♀️
We will also leave the details of the composition and atmosphere to you.
You may draw the clothes as you like. 🙇‍♀️
(It does not have to be a full-length portrait, but we would appreciate it if you can show the expression of the two people in a way that is pleasing to the eye.
We would appreciate it if you could include a background if possible for this price!

［Intended use]
For personal viewing, for wallpaper on iPads and smartphones.

If you have any difficulties with the time or the price, please feel free to cancel your request. 🙇‍♀️
I know I have asked you to be very detailed, but basically you can draw as you like!
I know it is difficult, but I would appreciate it if you would consider it.
Here are the details of the two OCs.
It is longer than the previous one, so you can read it if you like. 🙇‍♀️

My name is Orange_liner.
I have been looking at your illustrations on X, and when I found out that I can request them on skeb, I made a request.

I would like to ask you to draw my favorite Cure Sunny.
I would like a bust-up composition with a smiling expression.
I would appreciate your consideration. Thank you very much.

Sekiguchi-san, nice to meet you.
I saw your illustration of Cure Twinkle on Twitter and thought it was very nice, so I would like to request an illustration for GoPri.

I would like to request an illustration of Cure Flora from Go! Princess Precure.
I would like it to be like the illustration on https://twitter.com/mitemite_mitene/status/1702254056843227646, where Flora's legs and short boots can be seen (I have a shoe fetish).
The expression of Cure Flora should be a smile.
Other than the shoes and facial expressions, the composition, poses, etc. are all up to you.

Thank you in advance for your consideration.

I would like you to draw illustrations of Cure Beauty, Cure Marine and Cure Miracle for my Twitter icon. (I would like an illustration of each of them individually.)
I know it will be tough since there will be three of them, but if this is acceptable, I would appreciate it if you would consider my request.
